verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core architecture claim (skyvern-docs-5, skyvern-gh-1) is exactly this story: an AI layer over Playwright that maps visual/DOM elements to actions so it can operate on unseen sites without custom selectors. However, hands-on community testing (skyvern-comm-2) found it struggled to click a rental-car tab and failed on a popup on costcotravel.com, a concrete real-world failure of the 'survives layout changes' promise, while other users confirm the vision-based approach works on happy paths (skyvern-comm-4). missing for 10: independent benchmark data on selector/layout-change robustness, and no rebuttal to the documented failure case.
